description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewAPI class, a PHP REST API controller implementing CRUD operations for managing performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance review records, utilizing various traits and models for processing and validation.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewAPI
classes.description: PHP class implementing REST API endpoints for managing performance reviews, including listing, creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, with validation and business logic wrapped in methods.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all performance reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method query parameters.

methods.name: getFilterParams
methods.description: Parses and sets filter parameters for the performance review list based on request query parameters.

methods.name: getFilterParamRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules for individual filter parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new performance review, including validation and activation logic.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a performance review.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules used in create and update operations.

methods.name: setReviewParams
methods.description: Populates a PerformanceReview object with data from request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove specified performance reviews.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request for a single performance review by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rule for fetching a single review by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing performance review, including validation and activation logic.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a performance review.
